author: curriculum-architect
songSummary: Practices finding E and G, echoing short patterns, waiting for a turn and hearing how lines end, using a gentle rhyme about patient Bo-Peep.

classes.title: Peekaboo, Bo-Peep
classes.goal: Hear the whole song and play peekaboo at the long note that ends each line.

mathTarget.parentLine: Hearing where each line of the song stops and rests

classes.parentPrompt: Hide your eyes during each line; pop out with 'peekaboo' on the long last note.
classes.childAction: Hide your eyes, then say 'peekaboo' when the line ends.
classes.bridge: Each line is a little hiding game; the long note is peekaboo.

intro.caption: Bo-peep means peekaboo!
intro.parentCue: hide your eyes and wait for the long note

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: hearing where each line of a song ends.

classes.title: Trot like little sheep
classes.goal: Tap the big rocking beat on any key while the grown-up plays the tune.

mathTarget.parentLine: A rocking beat that comes back again and again

classes.parentPrompt: Rest your hand over your child's hand and tap the big beats, then slowly let go.
classes.childAction: Tap any key on each big beat, like trotting sheep.
classes.bridge: Lit-tle Bo-Peep: the taps land on 'Lit' and 'Peep', trot, trot.

intro.caption: Trot, trot, little sheep
intro.parentCue: bounce your child gently on each big beat

games.caption: Little Bo-Peep, trot trot
games.parentCue: Say 'trot, trot' on the big beats

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: tapping a steady rocking beat.

classes.title: Peekaboo E
classes.goal: Find E, just right of the two black keys, and play it with one finger.

mathTarget.parentLine: Using the two black keys as a sign to find E

classes.parentPrompt: Cover E with your hand, then lift it: 'Peekaboo, E!' Guide your child's finger there.
classes.childAction: Find two black keys, then press E like a button.
classes.bridge: Two black keys are the sheep's fence; E waits just past the fence.

intro.caption: Where is E hiding?
intro.parentCue: cover E with your hand, then lift it

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: finding E by the two black keys.

classes.title: Call the sheep
classes.goal: Listen to short calls of two or three notes and copy them back.

mathTarget.parentLine: Hearing a tiny tune and keeping it in mind to copy

classes.parentPrompt: Play or sing each call, pause, then nod to your child: 'Your turn.'
classes.childAction: Listen to the call, then play it back the same way.
classes.bridge: Bo-Peep calls her sheep; you call back the very same way.

intro.caption: I call, you call back
intro.parentCue: nod to your child for their turn

games.caption: Find them: E, F, G
games.parentCue: Say 'up, up, up' as they play

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: hearing short calls and copying them back.

classes.title: Hop down, hop down
classes.goal: Echo two little hops down and hear that they are the same hop, one step apart.

mathTarget.parentLine: The same little hop down, moved one step lower

classes.parentPrompt: Hop two fingers down your child's arm, then do the same hop a little lower.
classes.childAction: Echo G then E, then the same hop: F then D.
classes.bridge: A sheep hops over one key, then hops over one key again, lower.

intro.caption: Hop over one key
intro.parentCue: hop your fingers down your child's arm

games.caption: First hop: G, E
games.parentCue: Point to the key that gets skipped

games.caption: Same hop, lower: F, D
games.parentCue: Start one key to the left this time

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: spotting the same pattern, one step lower.

classes.title: Wait for the sheep's E
classes.goal: Wait and play E at the right moments while the grown-up plays the rest.

mathTarget.parentLine: I play my notes, you play yours: we take turns

classes.parentPrompt: Play your notes, then look at your child and nod just before each E.
classes.childAction: Finger ready, wait, then play E when it lights.
classes.bridge: Leave them alone and they'll come home: wait, and E comes.

intro.caption: Wait for E, like Bo-Peep
intro.parentCue: nod just before each E comes

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: waiting patiently and playing on your turn.

classes.title: Bo-Peep G, sheep E
classes.goal: Play two special notes, G and E, and tell them apart by ear and by place.

mathTarget.parentLine: Sorting notes into two groups: G notes and E notes

classes.parentPrompt: Say 'G' or 'E' aloud before each one; cheer for every one your child catches.
classes.childAction: Play G or E when it lights. G is higher, E is lower.
classes.bridge: G stands up high like Bo-Peep; E sits lower, like a little sheep.

intro.caption: Two notes: G and E
intro.parentCue: touch G, then E, and name each one

games.caption: Bo-Peep, sheep: G, E
games.parentCue: Name each note as it lights

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: telling two notes apart by ear and place.

classes.title: Bringing the sheep home
classes.goal: Play the whole song together, sharing one steady rocking beat.

mathTarget.parentLine: Two players keeping the same steady beat

classes.parentPrompt: Keep the beat going even if a note is missed; smile and nod at each turn.
classes.childAction: Play your notes in time with your grown-up's beat.
classes.bridge: Bo-Peep and her sheep walk home together, step by step.

intro.caption: Let's bring the sheep home
intro.parentCue: sit close and keep the beat steady

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: sharing one beat and taking turns.

classes.title: The sheep come home
classes.goal: Play the whole song for teddy and hear how lost becomes found at the end.

mathTarget.parentLine: Two lines start the same; one ends low, one ends high

classes.parentPrompt: Sit teddy as the audience; play, then wiggle like wagging tails, clap and bow.
classes.childAction: Play for teddy, then wag your tail and bow.
classes.bridge: Lost sheep end low and sad; found sheep end high and happy.

intro.caption: A song for teddy!
intro.parentCue: sit teddy in front as the audience

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: hearing how two similar lines end differently.
